contract.input: Command context, immutable definitions and injected logical time.
contract.authority: Only the session changes state, knowledge, inventory and stress.
contract.step: Build a candidate transition; validate before committing.
Advance memory and stress recovery independently; render their overlap without restarting either lifetime.
contract.invariant: Phone attention changes perceived context, not whether the world continues.
contract.reject: Preserve state and events on illegal or stale commands.

test.given: A player opens a phone during speech.
test.when: The session receives attention and time commands.
test.then: Perception reflects the actual interval; projections cannot grant missed knowledge.
